scope: BuildIT Vercel Sandbox dependency and subscription-exit impact

runner.credentials: short-lived broker-scoped token, teamId and projectId

impactIfRemoved: Without an equivalent isolated executor, review validation cannot run. Reviews that require execution will become unavailable or partial, findings cannot be safely published, and Autofix cannot prove its candidate. Static model review and Ask may still start, but their end-to-end result is not preserved.
requiredReplacementProof: no customer credentials in the execution environment
at least the current 700000ms workload and 800000ms request budgets
tenant limits and artifact access controls
production review, Ask, Autofix, cancellation, retry, stale-commit and publication-failure tests
decision: Keep the Sandbox dependency and the BuildIT Pro entitlement until an equivalent executor is deployed and the required production journeys pass.
